chapter: National Guard band and first jobs in Chicago
title: Dolly's mother and Turk as show-band readers
summary: Dolly sat in; her mother and uncle were strong sight readers from circus, shows and the Monogram Theater.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah, I see. Yeah, well that's -- yes. But -- so it was Dolly's mother, though, that was playing trumpet.
Dolly's mother, right. Dolly used to come in and sit in.

Her mother was a good reader too, because she played with those shows and circus too, and her uncle, called him Turk, he was (unintelligible) used to play at the old Monogram Theater had all these colored acts, and you had to
read all that stuff. Oh, he was a very good reader.
